title: Collect useful diagnostic details for human support

summary.text: Start with the minimal visible details that help staff identify the problem. Diagnostic archives are private evidence, not public knowledge.

problem.text: Logs diagnostics help contact human support report problem

symptoms.text: Logs diagnostics help contact human support report problem

user_phrases.text: Logs diagnostics help contact human support report problem

daedalus.notes: Interface source inspected at Daedalus 11.0.0. Later versions and specific OS releases require another review; safety advice is Ariadne editorial policy.

causes.claim: A symptom alone does not establish a cause.

resolutions.action: Note the application version, operating-system version, node state and synchronization phase. Include the exact error without personal information.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: Use Contact support on this page, verify your email and request a human. The Help Centre itself does not require login or an AI service.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: If staff requests a diagnostic ZIP, use the authenticated case attachment control. Do not paste logs publicly or include private wallet files.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

expected_outcome.text: Staff has a focused description and can request screened evidence if needed. This guide does not prescribe an unverified log-export sequence.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, private keys or spending passwords.
Do not delete, reset or move wallet data using generic instructions.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

prerequisites: Use the genuine application and keep private backups private.
consequences: Changing or approving wallet operations can affect funds.
recovery: Stop if unsure; contact human support before changing wallet data.

evidence.rationale: Official source inspection and Ariadne safety review; not wallet runtime testing.

faq.reason: Conservative source-reviewed introduction; not an exhaustive troubleshooting procedure.
